example.title: Old Coast Guard boathouse (1940), Cape May
example.place: Cape May, Cape May County, NJ

brief: A small white clapboard Coast Guard boathouse with a steep gable, a hooded door and a bronze historic plaque. Two photos. Older than 1970: the harbour station boathouse type is pre-war. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Coast Guard
